plugin.name: WinRM PowerShell
plugin.description: PowerShell sessions on Windows servers over WinRM, in a Termix terminal tab.

sessions.title: Open WinRM sessions
sessions.description: Open PowerShell sessions on hosts over WinRM.

run.title: Run WinRM scripts
run.description: Run PowerShell scripts on hosts over WinRM through the API and the winrm.run service, without a terminal. Every run is audited.

terminal.connected: Connected to {{computer}} over WinRM (PowerShell {{version}}). Full-screen and interactive console programs are not supported.

editor.httpNote: Every message is sealed with the NTLM session key, so commands and output are encrypted even on port 5985. The connection is refused if the server answers unencrypted. NTLM does not prove the server's identity; use HTTPS where that matters.
editor.httpsNote: TLS protects the connection and the login is bound to the server certificate. The certificate is always checked.
editor.caCertHint: For a certificate from your own CA, such as an Active Directory Certificate Services root. The name must match the host address.
editor.fingerprintHint: For a self-signed certificate. On the server: (Get-ChildItem Cert:\LocalMachine\My\<thumbprint>).GetCertHashString('SHA256')
editor.domainHint: The AD domain, or the computer name for a local account. Can stay empty with DOMAIN\user.

maxSessionsPerUser.label: Sessions per user
maxSessionsPerUser.description: How many WinRM sessions one user may have open at once.

maxSessionsTotal.label: Sessions in total
maxSessionsTotal.description: How many WinRM sessions the server keeps open at once.

idleTimeoutMinutes.label: Idle timeout (minutes)
idleTimeoutMinutes.description: A session with no input for this long is closed.
